slides.title: Have a Rest Card?
slides.vo: Have a Rest Card in your account? Before you use it, here's when you should apply it and when you should save it for later.
Use your Rest Card when you've had a low-step day and still have a contest deficit to clear.

slides.title: Adds 5,800 steps
slides.vo: For example, if your lowest eligible day has 4,200 steps, your Rest Card can add 5,800 steps, bringing it to 10,000.

slides.title: Smaller deficit
slides.vo: This can help you reduce your overall contest deficit.

slides.title: Save it for later
slides.vo: If there's no eligible low-step day that can benefit from the card, or you've already cleared your contest deficit, there's no reason to use it. Save it for later!

slides.title: Small gain? Decide
slides.vo: And if the benefit is very small, take a moment to decide whether you want to apply it or save it for another time.

slides.title: Plan ahead? Soon
slides.vo: One more thing! For now, you cannot schedule or plan your rest days in advance. We're working on bringing that soon. But you can apply your Rest Card anytime to any of your previous eligible low-step days.
My suggestion? Always check your potential impact before applying.

slides.title: Make it count
slides.vo: Use your card when it can make a real difference!
